Fit conditional growth references

Source: R/quant-condref.R
wgh_condref.Rd

Quantile regression of the target-age z-score on the baseline features, fitted separately by sex and target age over a grid of quantiles. The predicted quantiles for a new child form a personalised growth reference. Benchmarks fitted alongside: the unconditional reference (target quantiles ignoring the baseline), a persistence model (baseline plus the empirical distribution of change) and the WHO band (standard normal quantiles).

Usage

wgh_condref(
  panel,
  formula = ~baseline_haz + baseline_baz + baseline_age,
  taus = wgh_taus(c(0.03, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95, 0.97)),
  forest = FALSE
)

Arguments

panel

Output of wgh_conditional_panel().

formula

Right-hand side of the conditional model.

taus

Quantile grid (should include 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90 and 0.95 for scoring).

forest

Also fit a quantile random forest benchmark (wgh_quantile_forest(), needs ranger), available in predict() as type = "forest".

Value

An object of class wgh_condref.

Examples

# \donttest{
cp <- wgh_conditional_panel(growdat, targets = c(12, 15))
cr <- wgh_condref(cp)
cr
#> <wgh_condref>: 2 sex-by-target models, 9 quantiles
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   sex    target     n
#>   <chr>   <dbl> <int>
#> 1 Male       12    93
#> 2 Female     12    83
# }
